sources.entry: Muzei - Muzei wallpaper app for macOS.

summary.one_liner: A macOS menu bar wallpaper app, inspired by Android's Muzei live wallpaper, that sets daily famous artworks or top Reddit and Unsplash images as your desktop background.
summary.what_it_does: Muzei-macOS runs as a menu bar app and uses daily updated famous works of art as the desktop wallpaper. It can also pull top-scoring images from Reddit and Unsplash as wallpapers. The README says customization options include blurring, dimming, and choosing the subreddit. The project is based on the Muzei live wallpaper for Android by Roman Nurik. Pre-built binaries are offered on the Releases page, and the source builds with CocoaPods and Xcode.
use_cases: Set famous artwork as daily desktop wallpaper on a Mac
Rotate wallpapers from a chosen subreddit
Use Unsplash photos as macOS background
Blur or dim wallpaper behind desktop icons
Run a menu bar wallpaper changer
how_to_run: Download the app from the Releases page
notable: Reddit and Unsplash as wallpaper sources
Inspired by Android's Muzei live wallpaper
caveats: README gives no platform version requirements
Building from source requires CocoaPods and Xcode
README has no detailed feature documentation or screenshots shown in text
